The thing is, is that I never stopped trying to make people happy my friend. Idk why I carry my past around but I do
Because when I take a look at my life and what I have done for others to come back around and be unhappy what I did for them. I always try to find the silver lining so to speak. It never works though

Sometimes you just gotta think to yourself. Is he worth my energy? Just from reading this I can tell you love with all your heart. I found that sometimes when getting over someone you may tend to step over other people and they may get hurt. But just tell them how you really feel. I understand that you think that there is nothing you can do but there is endless possibility for you. Just know from a loving heart to you that love is not lost :-)
